rules.statement: Machine-readable NEXT F contracts are authoritative for canonical semantics.
The Site Manifest is authoritative for the project pinned version, enabled Modules, Capabilities, environments and bindings.
Customer requirements may choose supported presentation and behavior but may not silently redefine canonical semantics.
Existing code is implementation state, not authority over a canonical contract.
Examples and generated documentation are never more authoritative than their source contracts.
Security, tenant isolation, permissions and business invariants cannot be waived for implementation convenience.
